proposals.name: 60X
proposals.description: This route would offer a high-quality fast way to travel from west to east towards Brighton. It has been a historical bus route which has been slowly removed from the map. With a little love and attention, this route can be slightly adapted to give many more people a local bus stop with quick access into the city centre.

proposals.name: 700X
proposals.summary: Worthing Marine Parade → Brighton Old Steine
proposals.description: A fast, limited-stop express running along the existing 700 Coastliner corridor between Brighton and Worthing. Following the A259 coast road and calling only at the busiest stops, the 700X would cut the end-to-end journey time while keeping the through link the 700 already provides. This is achievable with no extra buses. Route 700 already runs frequently along the coast corridor, so re-badging half of the existing 700 trips as 700X gives every stop the same reliable frequent service AND gives commuters a faster express option into the city centres.

proposals.name: N2 Old Shoreham
proposals.summary: N2 service along Old Shoreham Road
proposals.description: A night bus from Brighton that stays on Old Shoreham Road through Hove, Portslade and Southwick, so the homes along it have a bus after dark. It then crosses the Shoreham Flyover on the A27 into Lancing, runs through Sompting and Broadwater, and finishes on Worthing seafront.

proposals.name: 98X
proposals.description: This route would establish an entirely new express travel corridor, tightly hugging the A27. Giving residents speedy and direct access to places they didn't before. This would create a brand new link between Patcham, Hangleton and Preston Park to places further west like Shoreham, Lancing and Worthing (via Hospital). Even an hourly or bi-hourly service would make Adur & Worthing so well better connected than they were previously.

proposals.name: Shoreham - Southwick Beach 3
proposals.summary: A summer-time service going between Shoreham and Southwick beaches via Train Stations
proposals.description: A peak-time, summer service. This would perfectly connect people to summer-time activities along the coast, giving people a direct connection from a train station or town centre to a local beach. Going from Shoreham Beach/Widewater to Shoreham and Southwick Train Stations and going along the coast to Hove Lagoon and continuing towards Carats Cafe at Southwick Beach.
